_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, checked (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated. Keep in sync with the version table in
docs/environment-setup.md -- changing a pin here means re-validating that
document and re-running sim/selftest.sh.
open_pdks          exact open_pdks commit hash the sky130 models must
come from (must match sim/pdk.json's
open_pdks_commit). Exact, because the hash IS the
device models: a different one silently yields
numbers no other record is comparable with. Set to
null to disable the check (not recommended).
ngspice_min_major  floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is
allowed and recorded; older is refused.
python_min         floor, as 'major.minor'.
xschem_tag         upstream release tag the netlisting toolchain is
built from (docs/environment-setup.md).
A drift is fatal by default; --allow-toolchain-drift overrides it and
stamps the drift into every record written under it.
Provenance: schema ported from 2AMLogic/gf180-sar-adc's
sim/toolchain.json (commit f613571aee5b80eff1eea37bdce9dfc88c5cf396),
per CLAUDE.md's 'Harness bootstrap' instruction -- values re-pinned
against this repo's own sky130 toolchain, not copied.
